scope_summary: Atomic precheck for one installed-skill rollout slice only. Verify artifact identity, bounded scope, affected file cluster, risk level, and evidence gate before janus-executioner starts. No product-code implementation, no routing-table activation, no new OR lane enablement.
acceptance_focus: target task identity is unique and consistent
scope stays bounded to the installed skill copies and one small workflow verification
required evidence is concrete and executable
no architecture drift or provider fallback is introduced
evidence_focus: repo-vs-installed parity or diff check for each bound skill copy
one visible approved lane workflow verification
